common_intent_requirements.text: 在粗糙木桌上轻推一个木块
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 在粗糙木桌上轻推一个木块
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a wooden block on a rough wooden tabletop, with the nearby table edge clearly visible and ample space between the block and that edge. A hand gives the block one gentle push along the surface, then lifts away completely.

common_intent_requirements.text: 手离开后让它滑一小段并停下
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 手离开后让它滑一小段并停下
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: The same block continues sliding a short distance after contact with the hand ends. Its motion gradually slows against the rough wood until it stops safely on the tabletop before reaching the edge.
until it stops safely on the tabletop before reaching the edge.

physics_checks.criterion: 手离开后木块仍有一段滑动，在无新外力的粗糙水平面上总体减速并停下。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 能看清手与木块分离，随后木块移动一段并在桌面静止。
fail_examples: 手刚离开木块就无过渡瞬移到终点
无新外力时木块持续加速
木块离桌悬浮滑行或变成带轮小车
not_required: 不测减速度或摩擦系数
不限定停止距离和滑行时间

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
